intent: The gods' observatory on the sea of cloud: a raised ivory terrace climbed by long balustraded flights, a great gilded armillary sphere of five rings turning over inlaid star-dials and a gold meridian cross, telescopes at the rim, lamps of holy light round the balustrade, and slow stars falling over it all: a monument the domain kit never had, made of its own carved instruments rather than its reused props.

critic.best_shot: feature-shots-final: armillary rings over the terrace with telescope
critic.why: Beautiful bespoke instruments, all recognisable; one centre per seed.

role: Landmark: observatory terrace at a route end or overlook.
notes:
# Q

Keep: Keep the armillary, star dial and telescope sculpts as they are.

1. Vary layout: two armillaries, terrace at a corner, long stairs on different sides.
2. Dress the terrace rim with balustrades so the drop reads.
3. Shrink the sphere a touch or move the game camera so it frames the terrace.
